info.title: Tomix.Cli
info.description: tx - open-source CLI for inspecting, validating, querying, testing, and deploying tabular semantic models (Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Analysis Services).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to semantic model (TMDL folder, .bim file, or TE folder)

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Stdout format: text (default), json, csv, tmsl (alias: bim), tmdl. Not all formats are supported by every command. [default: text]

options.name: --error-format
options.description: Stderr format for errors/warnings/hints: text (default) or json. Other values fall back to text.

options.name: --server
options.description: Workspace name or endpoint (e.g., MyWorkspace, powerbi://..., asazure://..., localhost)

options.name: --database
options.description: Semantic model name on the workspace

options.name: --auth
options.description: Auth method: auto, interactive, spn, managed-identity (default: auto)

options.name: --recent
options.description: Use a recently used model. No value = interactive picker, N = Nth most recent (1 = last used).

options.name: --debug
options.description: Show the full stack trace on stderr when an unexpected error occurs [default: False]

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Disable all interactive prompts. Fail with an actionable error if required input is missing. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompts for destructive operations [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress non-essential output (spinners, progress, hints). Errors and data still print. [default: False]

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add an object to the model

options.name: --type
options.description: Object type. Known values: Table, CalcTable, CalcGroup, Measure, CalcColumn, DataColumn, Hierarchy, Level, Calendar, CalcItem, KPI, Partition, MPartition, EntityPartition, PolicyRangePartition, Expression, Function, Perspective, Culture, ProviderDataSource, StructuredDataSource, Role, TablePermission, Member, Relationship. Data sources always require -t (no path keyword infers them).

options.name: -i
options.description: Expression or value for the new object. Use '-' to read from stdin. When paired with a preceding -q, applies as that property's value -- so you can set extra properties on the new object in one command, e.g. -i "SUM(...)" -q description -i "my measure" -q formatString -i "$#,0".

options.name: -q
options.description: Property name to set on the newly-created object. Pair each -q with a following -i value. Repeatable. Names accept dotted paths, bracket indexers, and DisplayName matching.

options.name: --file
options.description: Read expression from file

options.name: --if-not-exists
options.description: Succeed silently if the object already exists (exit 0) [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Save even if this mutation introduces validation errors [default: False]

options.name: --save-to
options.description: Save to a different path (implies --save)

options.name: --serialization
options.description: Model serialization: tmdl, bim (tmsl and auto also accepted)

options.name: --save
options.description: Persist this command's mutation to the source location. Mutually exclusive with --revert and --stage. [default: False]

options.name: --stage
options.description: Stage this command's mutation [default: False]

options.name: --revert
options.description: Revert a staged mutation [default: False]

options.name: --no-sync
options.description: Skip workspace sync when workspace mode is active. [default: False]

options.name: --mode
options.description: Partition storage mode: Import, DirectQuery, Dual, DirectLake, Push, Default.

options.name: --source
options.description: Provider name for a ProviderDataSource (e.g. System.Data.SqlClient).

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Server/endpoint address for a data source connection.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Full connection string for a ProviderDataSource.

options.name: --source-table
options.description: Source entity/table name for an EntityPartition.

options.name: --source-database
options.description: Source database name for a data source connection (Provider/Structured data sources).

options.name: --source-schema
options.description: Source schema name for an EntityPartition.

options.name: --partition-expression
options.description: M/DAX expression for a partition source.

options.name: --columns
options.description: Comma-separated column names to create on a new table (Table type only).

options.name: --source-type
options.description: Connection protocol for a StructuredDataSource (e.g. tds).

options.name: --range-start
options.description: Refresh-policy range start for a PolicyRangePartition (yyyy-MM-dd).

options.name: --range-end
options.description: Refresh-policy range end for a PolicyRangePartition (yyyy-MM-dd).

options.name: --range-granularity
options.description: Refresh-policy range granularity for a PolicyRangePartition: Day (default), Month, Quarter, Year.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Object path of the new object. Slash-separated: 'Sales/Revenue', 'Products', 'Admin'. DAX forms also accepted: "'Sales'[Revenue]". Pair with -t. Relationships use 'Sales[Key]->Product[Key]' (many side -> one side).

options.name: --device-code

options.name: --save
options.description: Persist service principal credentials for silent reuse (default: true). Use --save false for one-shot login.

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Set active connection (workspace, local path, or PBI Desktop). No args = show current. --recent = reconnect to a recently used model.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Enable workspace mode: mirror saves between the primary source and a secondary target. Primary remote -> pass a local folder or .bim file. Primary local -> pass <server> <database>. Pass -w with no value to pick the target workspace and model interactively.

options.name: --local
options.description: Connect to a locally running Power BI Desktop instance (Windows only) [default: False]

options.name: --remote
options.description: Pick a workspace and semantic model interactively from your Power BI tenant (requires a TTY; sign in first with 'tx auth login'). [default: False]

options.name: --profile
options.description: Activate a saved connection profile (see: tx profile list)

options.name: --clear
options.description: Clear the active connection from CLI config [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite a non-empty workspace target when initializing workspace mode. [default: False]

options.name: --workspace-format
options.description: On-disk format for a local workspace (tmdl, bim, te-folder). Defaults to path-detected.

options.name: --workspace-auth
options.description: Auth method for a remote workspace (local primary). Defaults to --auth if set, else auto.

arguments.name: SERVER
arguments.description: Workspace name, endpoint, local model path (TMDL/BIM), or omit with --local.

arguments.name: DATABASE
arguments.description: Semantic model name (omit on a TTY to pick from the workspace's models).

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Deploy a semantic model to a workspace (--xmla for script-only, --skip-bpa to bypass)

options.name: --profile
options.description: Use a saved connection profile for this deploy (one-shot, does not persist as active connection)

options.name: --create-only
options.description: Only create new model; fail if it already exists [default: False]

options.name: --xmla
options.description: Generate XMLA/TMSL script to file instead of deploying. Use '-' for stdout.

options.name: --skip-bpa
options.description: Skip BPA gate check (configured via .te-bpa.json) [default: False]

options.name: --fix-bpa
options.description: Auto-fix BPA violations before deploying (applies FixExpressions where available) [default: False]

options.name: --bpa-rules
options.description: Path(s) to BPA rule file(s) for this deploy. Overrides bpa.rules in CLI config.

options.name: --force
options.description: Force deployment, bypassing validation checks [default: False]

options.name: --ci
options.description: Emit CI logging commands to stderr: vsts (Azure DevOps), github (GitHub Actions)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview what would change on the remote target without deploying [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-connections
options.description: Overwrite the target's data sources (default: keep the target's connection strings) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-partitions
options.description: Overwrite the target's table partitions (default: keep the target's partitions and processed data) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-policy-partitions
options.description: With --deploy-partitions: also overwrite incremental-refresh policy partitions, discarding processed data (default: keep them) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-shared-expressions
options.description: Overwrite the target's shared expressions / M parameters (default: keep the target's values) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-roles
options.description: Overwrite the target's security roles (default: keep the target's roles) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-role-members
options.description: With --deploy-roles: also overwrite role members (default: keep the target's members) [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-full
options.description: Overwrite everything, including incremental-refresh partitions (cannot be combined with other --deploy-* flags) [default: False]

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Trigger a data refresh on a deployed model (--type full|auto|calculate|...)

options.name: --type
options.description: Refresh type: full, dataonly, automatic, calculate, clearvalues, defragment, add (default: automatic)

options.name: --table
options.description: Specific table(s) to refresh. If omitted, refreshes the entire model. Repeatable.

options.name: --partition
options.description: Specific partition(s) to refresh as TableName.PartitionName. Requires --table to be omitted. Repeatable.

options.name: --apply-refresh-policy
options.description: Apply incremental refresh policy (default: true). Set to false to skip policy-based partitioning.

options.name: --skip-refresh-policy
options.description: Shorthand for --apply-refresh-policy false. [default: False]

options.name: --effective-date
options.description: Override the current date for incremental refresh policy evaluation (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

options.name: --max-parallelism
options.description: Maximum parallel refresh operations.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Output the TMSL script without executing it. [default: False]

options.name: --no-progress
options.description: Disable live progress tracking (for CI/piping). [default: False]

options.name: --trace
options.description: Dump raw XMLA trace events. No value = stderr, path = write to log file.

commands.name: replace
commands.description: Find and replace text across model objects

options.name: --in
options.description: Scope: names, expressions, descriptions, displayFolders, formatStrings, annotations, all. 'all' covers every scope except annotations (explicit-only: values are often tool-generated JSON).

options.name: --regex
options.description: Treat pattern as a regular expression [default: False]

options.name: --case-sensitive
options.description: Enable case-sensitive matching [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview changes without applying [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Save even if the replacement introduces validation errors [default: False]

options.name: --stage
options.description: Stage this command's mutation [default: False]

options.name: --revert
options.description: Revert a staged mutation [default: False]

options.name: --no-sync
options.description: Skip workspace sync when workspace mode is active. [default: False]

options.name: --save
options.description: Persist this command's mutation to the source location [default: False]

options.name: --save-to
options.description: Save to a different path (implies --save)

options.name: --serialization
options.description: Model serialization: tmdl, bim (tmsl and auto also accepted)

arguments.name: PATTERN
arguments.description: Text or regex pattern to search for

commands.name: rm
commands.description: Remove an object from the model

options.name: --force
options.description: Force removal even if object has dependents [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be removed without saving [default: False]

options.name: --if-exists
options.description: Succeed silently if the object does not exist [default: False]

options.name: --save-to
options.description: Save to a different path (implies --save)

options.name: --serialization
options.description: Model serialization: tmdl, bim (tmsl and auto also accepted)

options.name: --type
options.description: Disambiguate when the path matches multiple table-children.

options.name: --save
options.description: Persist this command's mutation to the source location [default: False]

options.name: --stage
options.description: Stage this command's mutation [default: False]

options.name: --revert
options.description: Revert a staged mutation [default: False]

options.name: --no-sync
options.description: Skip workspace sync when workspace mode is active. [default: False]

commands.name: save
commands.description: Save a model to disk in a specified format (like fab export)

options.name: --output-path
options.description: File system path to write the model to. Omit to save the loaded model back to its source.

options.name: --serialization
options.description: Model serialization: tmdl, bim (tmsl and auto also accepted). Defaults to the loaded model's format.

options.name: --force
options.description: Skip validation and overwrite existing output. Does not override layout-safety refusals. [default: False]

options.name: --fix-bpa
options.description: Auto-fix BPA violations before saving (applies FixExpressions where available) [default: False]

options.name: --bpa-rules
options.description: Path(s) to BPA rule file(s) for this save. Overrides bpa.rules in CLI config.

options.name: --supporting-files
options.description: Wrap output in a {modelName}.SemanticModel/ folder with .platform and definition.pbism. Only for tmdl/bim on bare targets. [default: False]

options.name: --no-sync
options.description: Skip workspace sync when workspace mode is active. [default: False]

arguments.name: MODEL
arguments.description: Path to model, Fabric path, or omit for active connection

commands.name: script
commands.description: Execute C# script(s) against a semantic model

options.name: --script
options.description: Path(s) to .cs or .csx script file(s). Can be repeated.

options.name: --expression
options.description: Inline C# expression(s) to execute. Use '-' to read from stdin.

options.name: --save-to
options.description: Save model to a different path after all scripts execute

options.name: --serialization
options.description: Model serialization: tmdl, bim (tmsl and auto also accepted)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compile script and report errors without executing [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Save even if this mutation introduces DAX validation errors [default: False]

options.name: --save
options.description: Persist this command's mutation to the source location. Mutually exclusive with --revert and --stage. [default: False]

options.name: --stage
options.description: Stage this command's mutation [default: False]

options.name: --revert
options.description: Revert a staged mutation [default: False]

options.name: --no-sync
options.description: Skip workspace sync when workspace mode is active. [default: False]

arguments.name: MODEL
arguments.description: Path to model, Fabric path, or omit for active connection

commands.name: session
commands.description: Show or manage the current terminal session

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear active state for the current session

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all session files

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Delete session files whose shell process is no longer running

options.name: --all
options.description: Also remove named and live process sessions. The current session is kept. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be removed without doing it [default: False]

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show current session details (ID, file path, active state)

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a property on a model object

options.name: -q
options.description: Property expression.

options.name: -i
options.description: Value for the preceding -q. Use '-' to read from stdin.

options.name: --force
options.description: Allow --save-to to overwrite an existing target [default: False]

options.name: --type
options.description: Disambiguate when the path matches multiple objects (e.g. a measure and a partition sharing a name).

options.name: --save
options.description: Persist this command's mutation to the source location [default: False]

options.name: --save-to
options.description: Save to a different path (implies --save)

options.name: --serialization
options.description: Model serialization: tmdl, bim (tmsl and auto also accepted)

options.name: --stage
options.description: Stage this command's mutation [default: False]

options.name: --revert
options.description: Revert a staged mutation [default: False]

options.name: --no-sync
options.description: Skip workspace sync when workspace mode is active. [default: False]

options.name: --strict-refs
options.description: Fail when a rename leaves DAX references broken (with fixup on, only unfixable references fail). [default: False]

options.name: --no-fix-refs
options.description: Do not rewrite DAX references to the renamed object; warn instead. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Object path. Slash-separated paths and DAX forms are accepted.

commands.name: stage
commands.description: Inspect and manage staged (uncommitted) model mutations

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show staged mutations for the active model

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all staged models in the current session

commands.name: discard
commands.description: Discard staged mutations without committing them

options.name: --all
options.description: Discard staged mutations for every model in the session, not just the active one [default: False]

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Promote staged mutations onto the source (and workspace mirror)

options.name: --force
options.description: Commit even if the source changed since staging began (overwrites it). [default: False]

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run DAX regression tests against a live model (--update records snapshots, --trx/--ci for pipelines)

options.name: --update
options.description: Record mode: run each query and (re)write its .expected.json snapshot from the actual result. [default: False]

options.name: --filter
options.description: Run only tests whose name matches a * wildcard pattern (case-insensitive).

options.name: --param
options.description: Query parameter as name=value, referenced as @name in DAX. Applied to every test. Repeatable.

options.name: --max-rows
options.description: Per-query row cap; a query exceeding it fails as an error (default: 10000).

options.name: --ci
options.description: Emit CI logging commands to stderr: vsts or github

options.name: --trx
options.description: Write results as a VSTEST .trx file to the specified path

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Test file or directory searched recursively for .dax tests (default: current directory) [default: .]

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update tx to the latest release.

options.name: --check
options.description: Preview only: show the latest version and release notes without changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --version
options.description: Update (or downgrade, with --yes) to a specific released version instead of the latest.

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Stdout format: text (default), json, csv, tmsl (alias: bim), tmdl. Not all formats are supported by every command. [default: text]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate DAX expressions and relationship integrity (--ci for CI output, --trx for VSTEST)

options.name: --ci
options.description: Emit CI logging commands to stderr: vsts or github

options.name: --trx
options.description: Write results as a VSTEST .trx file to the specified path

options.name: --errors-only
options.description: Only show errors [default: False]

options.name: --no-warnings
options.description: Hide warnings from the semantic analyzer [default: False]

options.name: --no-multiline
options.description: Collapse multi-line cell content to a single line. Text output only. [default: False]

options.name: --server-only
options.description: Only show errors reported by the connected server [default: False]

commands.name: vertipaq
commands.description: Analyze VertiPaq storage statistics for a semantic model

options.name: --tables
options.description: Show the tables view [default: False]

options.name: --columns
options.description: Show the columns view (default) [default: False]

options.name: --relationships
options.description: Show the relationships view [default: False]

options.name: --partitions
options.description: Show the partitions view [default: False]

options.name: --all
options.description: Show tables, columns, relationships, and partitions [default: False]

options.name: --detail
options.description: Expanded columns: data/dictionary/hierarchy size breakdown, encoding, segments [default: False]

options.name: --fields
options.description: Comma-separated fields to display (e.g. name,card,size,%tbl,%db,bar). Available fields vary by view; requires a single view. Text and csv output only.

options.name: --top
options.description: Limit each view to the N largest rows. Text and csv output only.

options.name: --stats
options.description: Show a model-level storage summary (combine with view flags for more) [default: False]

options.name: --annotate
options.description: Write statistics into the model as Vertipaq_* annotations (preview unless --save) [default: False]

options.name: --save
options.description: Persist --annotate changes to the model [default: False]

options.name: --export
options.description: Export statistics to a .vpax file for offline analysis

options.name: --import
options.description: Analyze a previously exported .vpax file offline (no connection needed)

options.name: --obfuscate
options.description: Obfuscate names and expressions in the exported .vpax; writes a private .dict dictionary [default: False]

arguments.name: TABLE
arguments.description: Table name to filter the analysis to a single table
